rows.note: Use 啱 as the all-purpose choice when something is factually correct, accurate, or the right match.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daap3 on3 hai6 ngaam1 ge3

rows.note: Use 真實 when stressing that a story, event, or account is real rather than fictional.

example.english: This story is true, not made up.
example.traditional: 呢個故事係真實嘅，唔係作出嚟嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 hai6 zan1 sat6 ge3 m4 hai6 zok3 ceot1 lei4 ge3

rows.note: Use 真正 for something genuinely or legitimately of the stated kind, such as a true king.

example.jyutping: keoi5 sin1 hai6 zan1 zing3 ge3 gun3 gwan1

rows.note: Use 忠心 when true means loyal or faithful to a person or cause.

example.english: The dog is true to its owner.
example.jyutping: aa3 gau2 deoi3 zyu2 jan4 hou2 zung1 sam1
